document.title: Image diffs stay at 60 fps with 100 screenshots in one group
document.summary: `serve` reads the pinned diff once, and image cards load by screen priority and diff pixels in a worker.
document.why: With hundreds of screenshot diffs in one group, [image sliders lagged and the review was slow](source:s1), locally and hosted.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Nov 25
sources.gist: 100 screenshots in one group lag; reach 60 fps, same UX.

lookFor: The [session](source:s1) asks for no change to the user experience. At head, a card whose images have not arrived shows an empty frame at the first image's size with a hidden caption, and in Pixel diff each canvas fills when its worker job ends, about 0.3 s per pair.

parts.name: Serve
parts.summary: `serve` stops recomputing the same diff on every request.

parts.name: Image cards
parts.summary: Image cards load by screen priority and diff pixels off the main thread.

groups.title: Cache the pinned diff
groups.summary: `readDiff` keeps the promise for a pair of full SHAs, so every `serve` request after the first reuses one diff.

attention.note: `readDiff` now returns one shared array for the same SHA pair, typed `readonly DiffFile[]`. The type stops a caller from pushing or sorting the array, but not from changing a `DiffFile` inside it: such a write would show in every later request until the process ends. No caller writes to a `DiffFile` at head.

notes.body: `serve` passes the SHAs `pinReviewSource` resolved at startup, so its calls hit the cache.
A failed read leaves the cache, so the next request tries git again.

fileNotes.src/git/diff.ts: Adds a four-entry cache keyed by cwd and both SHAs.
fileNotes.src/git/diff.test.ts: Commits `later.ts` after a read of `HEAD`; a cache by ref name would miss it.

groups.title: Accept the readonly diff
groups.summary: Each function that takes the diff now takes `readonly DiffFile[]`. The reader can skip it: only parameter types change.

fileNotes.src/api/live.ts: `ReviewContext.files` and five helpers take a readonly array.
fileNotes.src/git/moved.test.ts: The test helper `movedKeys` takes a readonly array.

groups.title: Load images by screen priority
groups.summary: `ImageDiff` asks `useImage` for each side with the card's place from `useViewportPriority`: on screen, within 1.5 screens, or far.

attention.note: `image-loader.ts` keeps every finished image as a Blob with an object URL for the page's life, and never revokes them: about 340 MB for 100 screenshot pairs. In return no image downloads twice, since `serve` sends image URLs with `no-store`, and the pixel diff worker reads the same Blob. Chrome moves large blobs to disk.

focus.caption: Only the best missing rank starts; screen images preempt near ones.

notes.body: A card the scroll passed stops its download, so where the scroll stops loads first.
The single background download stops while any screen or near image is missing.
The root is `main` in `ReviewStage`, the page's scroll container.

fileNotes.src/ui/lib/image-loader.ts: New: ranked fetch queue, 4 foreground and 1 background slots, Blob cache.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/near-viewport.ts: New: two observers give visible, near, or background.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/ImageDiff.tsx: Replaces `useLoadedImage` with `useImage`; images render from object URLs.

groups.title: Pixel diff in a worker
groups.summary: `PixelStage` hands the loaded Blobs to `queuePixelDiff`, and the worker decodes them and runs the same `diffRgba`.

attention.note: The worker needs `OffscreenCanvas` and `createImageBitmap` (Safari 16.4+, Firefox 105+). In an older browser the job fails, and the card shows "The pixels could not be compared" where the main-thread diff worked before. Only cards near the screen get a job, and a job that has not started is dropped when its card scrolls away.

notes.body: Twelve kept bitmaps cover a return to cards just scrolled past.

fileNotes.src/ui/lib/pixel-diff.ts: New: one-at-a-time job queue with cancel and a kept-result cache.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/pixel-diff.worker.ts: New: decodes both Blobs and diffs them on `OffscreenCanvas`.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/ImageDiff.tsx: `PixelStage` takes loaded images, not `` elements; `raster` moves to the worker.

commits.subject: Image diffs: the background fill waits while screen images are missing
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The one background download kept a fifth of the link during a scroll, and could start on a far card before the observers reported. The pixel diff cache builds its key from the image URLs again, so a caller cannot pass a wrong one.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Image diffs: screen images load first, passed ones stop loading
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Scrolling to the bottom of 100 screenshots on a 3.5 MB/s link left the bottom cards empty for 89 s: every card the scroll passed kept its download. One loader now ranks images (on screen, near, background), cancels the ones a scroll left, and keeps each file as a blob that the pixel diff worker reuses.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Image diffs: load pixels near the screen, diff them in a worker
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
A group with 100 screenshots loaded every image at once, and Pixel diff froze the page for 28 s while it diffed them all on the main thread.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Serve: read the pinned diff once, not on every request
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
With hundreds of binaries, rename and copy detection took about a second per API call, so each image took a second to serve.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
